plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and address its below-stop status.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to zero for capital preservation.
Sell SMH and SMCI as they are below stop and in a downtrend.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation by eliminating high-risk holdings and reducing concentration.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a target of ~1.5%/month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces risk by cutting all leveraged ETFs and positions below their stops. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest returns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and address its below-stop status.
Reduce leveraged ETF exposure by trimming SOXL to 3%, SPAL to 1%, MUU to 2%, and PLTU to 1%.
Buy ON at 4% as a strong scanner setup to add quality tech exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth by reducing overall leverage and adding a high-quality new name.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns, with a blend of broad index and quality tech.

plan: Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration and address its below-stop status.
Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs by adding to SOXL, SPAL, MUU, and PLTU, targeting 6% each.
Buy ON at 6% and TSLA at 6% as strong scanner setups to lean into growth.
This plan uses leverage and concentrates in high-scoring setups for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month, aiming for stretch growth. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring scanner setups. Be aware this strategy carries substantially higher risk, including larger potential drawdowns and daily decay of leveraged ETFs. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to increase income exposure.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to zero.
Sell METU and MSFU to reduce high-beta single name exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdown over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It prioritizes income and broad index exposure while cutting high-beta and leveraged positions. While aiming for steady distributions, remember these are variable, and NAV can still fall in market downturns. This is not a savings account.
